class.name: AnnotationUtils
class.brief_description: Read-time helpers for user GDScript annotations.
class.description: Looks up annotations stored by [method GDScript.get_annotations] and, when asked, builds an object from one entry. Nothing in this class runs when a script loads. [method instantiate_annotation] allocates a [RefCounted], attaches the annotation script, and copies attribute values into the member store. It does not call [code]_init[/code] or setters. The [code]_initialized[/code] methods do that only for the matches they return. A query matches the requested annotation class and any annotation class that extends it. The entry name stays the class that was applied. [method for_each_annotation] reads one script. [method for_each_annotation_in_bases] reads that script's base scripts, nearest first, and does not include the script itself. [method has_annotation] stays a dictionary check and does not construct. Walk callbacks and [method find_annotated] return the [ReflectionUtils] views ([ScriptInfo], [VariableInfo], [FunctionInfo], [ParameterInfo]).

method.name: find_annotated
method.description: Returns one reflection view per match on [param script], in source order: [ScriptInfo], [VariableInfo], [FunctionInfo], or [ParameterInfo]. Two classes on one member are two views with the same script and name.

method.name: find_annotated_initialized
method.description: Same matches and order as [method find_annotated]. Each element is an object from [method instantiate_annotation], not a reflection view. Objects are created only for those matches. A caller who needs the view as well uses [method for_each_annotation_initialized].

method.name: for_each_annotation
method.description: Calls [param callback] once per match on [param script]. The callback receives the applied class name, the folded values dictionary, and the matching [ReflectionUtils] view.

method.name: for_each_annotation_in_bases
method.description: Same callback as [method for_each_annotation], walking [method GDScript.get_base_script] from the nearest base upward. Does not visit [param script] itself.

method.name: for_each_annotation_in_bases_initialized
method.description: Same base walk as [method for_each_annotation_in_bases]. The callback receives the annotation object and the matching [ReflectionUtils] view. One annotation object is created per match.

method.name: for_each_annotation_initialized
method.description: Same matches and single-script walk as [method for_each_annotation]. The callback receives the annotation object and the matching [ReflectionUtils] view. One annotation object is created per match.

method.name: get_annotation
method.description: Returns the first matching entry, or [code]null[/code]. An empty [param member] and [param parameter] select the script header only. The entry is [code]{ "name": StringName, "values": Dictionary }[/code]. [code]name[/code] is the applied class.

method.name: get_annotation_initialized
method.description: Same lookup as [method get_annotation], including the script header when [param member] and [param parameter] are empty. Returns [method instantiate_annotation] of that first entry, or [code]null[/code] when there is no match.

method.name: get_annotation_values
method.description: Returns the folded values dictionary of the first match, or [code]null[/code]. Same target rules as [method get_annotation].

method.name: has_annotation
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [method get_annotation] would return an entry. An empty [param member] checks the script header only.

method.name: instantiate_annotation
method.description: Builds a new [RefCounted] for one [method GDScript.get_annotations] entry and returns it. The object's script is the annotation class named by the entry. Array and dictionary attributes are mutable copies. The stored bag stays read-only.
